title: Sparkly spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="bodyGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b8a"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#e63950"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b81d33"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="tipGrad" cx="50%" cy="30%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d4a017"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffe066">
    <polygon points="18,25 20,20 22,25 27,27 22,29 20,34 18,29 13,27"/>
    <polygon points="82,20 84,15 86,20 91,22 86,24 84,29 82,24 77,22"/>
    <polygon points="15,55 17,50 19,55 24,57 19,59 17,64 15,59 10,57"/>
    <polygon points="85,50 87,45 89,50 94,52 89,54 87,59 85,54 80,52"/>
    <polygon points="50,10 52,5 54,10 59,12 54,14 52,19 50,14 45,12"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#80e0ff">
    <polygon points="30,15 31.5,12 33,15 36,16.5 33,18 31.5,21 30,18 27,16.5"/>
    <polygon points="70,12 71.5,9 73,12 76,13.5 73,15 71.5,18 70,15 67,13.5"/>
    <polygon points="12,38 13.5,35 15,38 18,39.5 15,41 13.5,44 12,41 9,39.5"/>
    <polygon points="88,38 89.5,35 91,38 94,39.5 91,41 89.5,44 88,41 85,39.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top body - spinning top shape -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="28" ry="8" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
  <path d="M22,45 Q22,25 40,18 Q48,15 50,13 Q52,15 60,18 Q78,25 78,45 Z" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="28" ry="8" fill="#ffb3c1" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Stripe bands -->
  <path d="M24,38 Q50,32 76,38" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M24,45 Q50,39 76,45" stroke="#80e0ff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Top handle -->
  <rect x="47" y="10" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#d4a017"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="9" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ffe066"/>

  <!-- Tip -->
  <path d="M44,53 Q50,68 50,72 Q50,68 56,53 Z" fill="url(#tipGrad)"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="71" r="2.5" fill="#fff9c4"/>

  <!-- Motion swirl lines -->
  <path d="M15,42 Q12,45 15,48" stroke="#80e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M85,42 Q88,45 85,48" stroke="#80e0ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M18,50 Q15,53 18,56" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M82,50 Q85,53 82,56" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Highlight on body -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="30" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#fff" opacity="0.2" transform="rotate(-15 42 30)"/>
</svg>
